### Changed

- (auth) [Read a token broker outage from the 503 status alone](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3505) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — For operators: the cluster token exchange treats any 503 from the token broker as an outage, so it still reports `Token broker is temporarily unavailable` now that mcp-oauth v1.13.7 and muster answer one without an error code.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.38.8...v3.38.9
